description: Customer API tool: requires LIENDEADLINE_API_KEY with the states:read scope. Returns count and the two-letter codes of the jurisdictions the customer invoice calculation accepts. It does not list editorial guides or the states with reviewed supplier baselines. Takes no parameters. Read-only.
